```{r load-data}
kpi_summary <- read.csv(file.path(eval_dir, "kpi_summary_reffix.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER),
         epsilon_label = ifelse(is.infinite(epsilon), "Inf", as.character(epsilon)))

kpi_var <- read.csv(file.path(eval_dir, "kpi_variable_detail_reffix.csv"),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER))

lsr_detail <- read.csv(file.path(eval_dir, "lsr_detail_reffix.csv"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER))

fpr_detail <- read.csv(file.path(eval_dir, "fpr_detail_reffix.csv"),
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER))

kpi_tt <- read.csv(file.path(eval_dir, "kpi_traintest_reffix.csv"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER),
         epsilon_label = ifelse(is.infinite(epsilon), "Inf", as.character(epsilon)))

baseline_all <- read.csv(file.path(project_dir, "data/01_prepared/baseline_cox_reffix.csv"),
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

baselines_insample <- sapply(DATASET_ORDER, function(ds)
  get_kpi(kpi_summary, ds, Inf, "Phase 1", "mean_c"))

baselines_test <- sapply(DATASET_ORDER, function(ds)
  get_kpi(kpi_tt, ds, Inf, "Phase 1", "mean_c_test"))
```

```{r baseline}
Q_VALUES <- c(lung = 7L, pbc = 17L, colon = 11L, rotterdam = 9L, flchain = 7L)

N_COEF_TBL <- read.csv(file.path(project_dir, "main/06_report/output/tabS5_variable_types.csv"),
                       check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
N_COEF <- setNames(as.integer(N_COEF_TBL[["Cox coef."]]), N_COEF_TBL$Dataset)
stopifnot(setequal(names(N_COEF), DATASET_ORDER),
          identical(unname(N_COEF[DATASET_ORDER]),
                    as.integer(table(baseline_all$dataset)[DATASET_ORDER])))
stopifnot(all(N_COEF[DATASET_ORDER] >= Q_VALUES[DATASET_ORDER]))

sig_vars_str <- function(ds) {
  sub <- baseline_all[baseline_all$dataset == ds, ]
  sig <- sub[sub$p_value < 0.05, ]
  sprintf("%d/%d (%s)", nrow(sig), N_COEF[ds], paste(sig$variable, collapse = ", "))
}

datasets_tbl <- tibble(
  Dataset = DATASET_ORDER,
  N = as.integer(c(168, 312, 929, 2982, 6524)),
  Events = as.integer(c(121, 125, 468, 1518, 1962)),
  q = as.integer(c(7, 17, 11, 9, 7)),
  `Event rate` = round(Events / N, 3),
  `C-index` = baselines_insample,
  `Test C-index` = baselines_test,
  `Sig. coef.` = sapply(DATASET_ORDER, sig_vars_str)
)

save_tbl(datasets_tbl, paste0("tab1_baseline", RF), digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 3, 3, 0),
         tex_transform = function(d) { d[["Sig. coef."]] <- gsub(">", "$>$", d[["Sig. coef."]], fixed = TRUE); d })

kable(datasets_tbl,
      caption = "Dataset characteristics and baseline Cox regression results.",
      digits = 3,
      booktabs = TRUE,
      linesep = "") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"),
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r fig-lsr, fig.cap="Loss of Significance Rate (LSR) by privacy budget across three input perturbation approaches and five datasets. Triangular markers at the rightmost position denote the non-private baseline (epsilon = infinity), where the LSR is 0 for all three approaches and the markers coincide.", fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
lsr_plot_data <- kpi_summary %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3")) %>%
  mutate(
    x_pos = ifelse(is.infinite(epsilon), 10000, epsilon),
    is_inf = is.infinite(epsilon),
    dataset_label = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER, labels = DATASET_LABELS),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = names(PHASE_COLORS))
  )

stopifnot(sum(lsr_plot_data$is_inf) == 3L * length(DATASET_ORDER),
          all(lsr_plot_data$mean_lsr[lsr_plot_data$is_inf] == 0))
cat(sprintf("fig1: LSR at epsilon = Inf is exactly 0 in all %d cells (dataset x phase)\n",
            sum(lsr_plot_data$is_inf)))

p_lsr <- ggplot(lsr_plot_data,
       aes(x = x_pos, y = mean_lsr, color = phase, shape = phase)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = function(d) d[!d$is_inf, ], size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = function(d) d[d$is_inf, ], shape = 17, size = 2.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(3, 10), linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 1, 3, 10, 100, 1000, 10000),
                labels = c("0.1", "1", "3", "10", "100", "1k",
                           expression(infinity))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = PHASE_COLORS, labels = PHASE_LABELS) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15), labels = PHASE_LABELS) +
  labs(x = expression(paste("Privacy budget  ", epsilon)),
       y = "Loss of Significance Rate (LSR)",
       color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_main_fig() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

save_fig(p_lsr, paste0("fig1_lsr", RF), width = 12, height = 5)
p_lsr

```{r beta-data}
beta_detail <- kpi_var %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3")) %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = names(PHASE_COLORS)))

TOP_N_VARS <- 5

sig_vars_all <- baseline_all %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  select(dataset, variable) %>%
  mutate(is_sig = TRUE)

top_vars <- baseline_all %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  slice_max(abs(beta), n = TOP_N_VARS, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(sig_vars_all, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(
    is_sig = ifelse(is.na(is_sig), FALSE, TRUE),
    var_label = ifelse(is_sig, paste0(variable, "*"), variable)
  ) %>%
  select(dataset, variable, beta_baseline = beta, is_sig, var_label)
```

```{r fig-hr-distribution, fig.cap="Hazard ratio (HR) under Phase 1 (covariates-only) perturbation for the top 5 covariates by absolute baseline coefficient in each dataset. Dots show mean HR over B=1000 iterations; error bars show plus/minus 1 SD. Cross marks denote the non-private baseline HR (epsilon = infinity). The dashed line at HR = 1.0 is the null hypothesis of no effect. At low epsilon, all HRs collapse toward 1.0, indicating complete loss of effect size. Variables are sorted by descending baseline coefficient.", fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
hr_raw <- as.data.frame(arrow::read_parquet(
  file.path(sim_dir, "reffix_traintest/all_phase1_reffix_traintest.parquet")))
stopifnot(setequal(unique(hr_raw$dataset), DATASET_ORDER))

eps_show_hr <- c(1, 10, 100, 1000, Inf)

hr_summary <- hr_raw %>%
  semi_join(top_vars, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  filter(epsilon %in% eps_show_hr,
         converged == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(dataset, variable, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_hr = mean(hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_hr = sd(hr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(top_vars, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(
    is_baseline = is.infinite(epsilon),
    epsilon_label = factor(
      ifelse(is.infinite(epsilon), "\u221E", as.character(epsilon)),
      levels = EPSILON_LEVELS
    ),
    dataset_label = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER, labels = DATASET_LABELS),
    pt_shape = ifelse(is_baseline, "baseline", "dp"),
    sd_hr = ifelse(is_baseline, 0, sd_hr)
  )

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

p_hr_dist <- ggplot(hr_summary,
       aes(x = reorder(var_label, -beta_baseline), y = mean_hr,
           color = epsilon_label, group = epsilon_label)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_hr - sd_hr, ymax = mean_hr + sd_hr),
    position = pd, width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = pt_shape),
    position = pd, size = 2, stroke = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("dp" = 16, "baseline" = 4), guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset_label, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = EPSILON_COLORS,
    name = expression(epsilon)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Hazard Ratio (HR)") +
  theme_paper() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.18),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "grey80"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(
    reverse = TRUE,
    override.aes = list(shape = c(4, 16, 16, 16, 16))
  ))

save_fig(p_hr_dist, paste0("fig3_hr_distribution", RF), width = 12, height = 7)
p_hr_dist
```

```{r fig-beta-bias-allvars, fig.cap="Signed relative HR bias (HR_DP / HR_baseline - 1) for the top 5 covariates per dataset under Phase 1 perturbation at four epsilon levels. Asterisks mark covariates significant at baseline (p < 0.05). Variables are sorted by descending baseline coefficient (same order as the preceding HR distribution figure). Lower epsilon produces stronger attenuation toward HR = 1.0, but the sign of bias is always toward the null.", fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
EPS_LEVELS_FINITE <- c("1", "10", "100", "1000")

hr_bias_data <- kpi_var %>%
  filter(phase == "Phase 1",
         !is.infinite(epsilon),

  semi_join(top_vars, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  left_join(top_vars, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset_label = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER, labels = DATASET_LABELS),
    epsilon_label = factor(as.character(epsilon), levels = EPS_LEVELS_FINITE)
  )

p_hr <- ggplot(hr_bias_data,
       aes(x = reorder(var_label, -beta_baseline), y = hr_rel_bias,

  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset_label, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = EPSILON_COLORS[EPS_LEVELS_FINITE],
    name = expression(epsilon)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Relative HR bias (HR_DP / HR_baseline - 1)") +
  theme_paper() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.18),

    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))

save_fig(p_hr, paste0("fig4_hr_bias", RF), width = 12, height = 7)

```{r threshold-table}
thresh_c <- kpi_tt %>%
  unify_output() %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3", "Output")) %>%
  left_join(
    kpi_tt %>%
      unify_output() %>%
      filter(is.infinite(epsilon)) %>%
      select(dataset, phase, base_c = mean_c_test),
    by = c("dataset", "phase")
  ) %>%
  mutate(delta = base_c - mean_c_test) %>%
  filter(!is.infinite(epsilon), delta <= 0.05) %>%
  group_by(dataset, phase) %>%
  summarise(eps_c05 = min(epsilon), .groups = "drop")

thresh_lsr <- kpi_summary %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3"),
         !is.infinite(epsilon),
         mean_lsr <= 0.5) %>%
  group_by(dataset, phase) %>%
  summarise(eps_lsr50 = min(epsilon), .groups = "drop")

thresh_lsr10 <- kpi_summary %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3"),
         !is.infinite(epsilon),
         mean_lsr <= 0.1) %>%
  group_by(dataset, phase) %>%
  summarise(eps_lsr10 = min(epsilon), .groups = "drop")

fpr_agg_thresh <- fpr_detail %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3"),
         is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, phase, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

thresh_fpr <- fpr_agg_thresh %>%
  arrange(dataset, phase, desc(epsilon)) %>%
  group_by(dataset, phase) %>%
  mutate(max_fpr_above = cummax(mean_fpr)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(max_fpr_above <= 0.10) %>%
  group_by(dataset, phase) %>%
  summarise(eps_fpr10 = min(epsilon), .groups = "drop")

min_eps_tested <- min(fpr_agg_thresh$epsilon)

thresh_combined <- thresh_c %>%
  full_join(thresh_lsr, by = c("dataset", "phase")) %>%
  full_join(thresh_lsr10, by = c("dataset", "phase")) %>%
  full_join(thresh_fpr, by = c("dataset", "phase")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(eps_c05, eps_lsr50, eps_lsr10),
           ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "> 1000", as.character(.x))),
    across(c(eps_lsr50, eps_lsr10), ~ ifelse(phase == "Output", "---", .x)),
    eps_fpr10 = case_when(
      phase == "Output" ~ "---",
      is.na(eps_fpr10) ~ "> 1000",
      eps_fpr10 <= min_eps_tested ~ "---",
      TRUE ~ as.character(eps_fpr10)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset, phase)

save_tbl(thresh_combined, paste0("tab4_threshold", RF), digits = 0,
        col.names = c("Dataset", "Phase",
                       "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\Delta C \\leq 0.05}$",
                       "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\text{LSR} \\leq 0.5}$",
                       "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\text{LSR} \\leq 0.1}$",
                       "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\text{FPR} \\leq 0.10}$"))

kable(thresh_combined,
      caption = "Minimum $\\varepsilon$ to achieve utility thresholds. The FPR threshold ($\\varepsilon^*_{\\text{FPR}}$) is the minimum $\\varepsilon$ beyond which mean FPR remains at or below 10\\%, i.e., the right tail of the FPR hump.",
      col.names = c("Dataset", "Phase",
                     "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\Delta C \\leq 0.05}$",
                     "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\text{LSR} \\leq 0.5}$",
                     "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\text{LSR} \\leq 0.1}$",
                     "$\\varepsilon^*_{\\text{FPR} \\leq 0.10}$"),
      escape = FALSE,
      booktabs = TRUE,
      linesep = "") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"),
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
```

p_lsr_var <- ggplot(lsr_lung,
       aes(x = epsilon, y = lsr, color = phase, shape = phase)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
                labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100", "1k")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = PHASE_COLORS, labels = PHASE_LABELS) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15), labels = PHASE_LABELS) +
  labs(x = expression(epsilon), y = "LSR", color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_paper()

save_fig(p_lsr_var, paste0("figS1_lsr_per_variable", RF), width = 8, height = 4)
p_lsr_var

```{r fig-overfit, fig.cap="Overfitting gap (C_train minus C_test) vs. privacy budget, faceted by approach. Each line represents one dataset. The y-axis range is unified across all four panels to enable direct comparison. Phase 2 and Output (dfbeta) exhibit large negative gaps at intermediate epsilon, indicating worse-than-random in-sample performance due to noise.", fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
gap_data <- kpi_tt %>%
  unify_output() %>%
  filter(!is.infinite(epsilon)) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset_label = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER, labels = DATASET_LABELS),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = names(PHASE_COLORS)),
    phase_label = factor(phase, levels = names(PHASE_COLORS), labels = PHASE_LABELS)
  )

y_range <- range(gap_data$overfit_gap, na.rm = TRUE)
y_pad <- diff(y_range) * 0.05
y_lim <- c(y_range[1] - y_pad, y_range[2] + y_pad)

p_gap <- ggplot(gap_data,
       aes(x = epsilon, y = overfit_gap, color = dataset_label,
           shape = dataset_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ phase_label, nrow = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
                labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100", "1k")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim) +
  labs(x = expression(epsilon),
       y = expression(C[train] - C[test]),
       color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_paper() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1),
         shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

save_fig(p_gap, paste0("figS2_overfit_gap", RF), width = 12, height = 8)
p_gap
```

```{r fig-fpr-summary, fig.cap="Mean FPR vs privacy budget across five datasets (input perturbation only).", fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
fpr_input <- fpr_detail %>%
  unify_output() %>%
  filter(phase %in% c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3"),
         is.finite(epsilon))

fpr_agg <- fpr_input %>%
  group_by(dataset, epsilon, phase) %>%
  summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    dataset_label = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER, labels = DATASET_LABELS),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = names(PHASE_COLORS))
  )

p_fpr <- ggplot(fpr_agg, aes(x = epsilon, y = mean_fpr, color = phase, shape = phase)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset_label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
                labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100", "1k")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = PHASE_COLORS, labels = PHASE_LABELS) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15), labels = PHASE_LABELS) +
  labs(x = expression(epsilon), y = "Mean FPR",
       color = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_main_fig()

save_fig(p_fpr, paste0("figS3_fpr", RF), width = 12, height = 5)
p_fpr
```

```{r fig-fpr-by-variable, fig.cap="Per-variable false positive rate (FPR) for the PBC dataset (q=17, highest number of baseline non-significant variables), faceted by input perturbation phase. The y-axis range is unified across panels. The dashed line indicates the nominal alpha = 0.05 level. FPR peaks at intermediate epsilon (10--100) for variables whose baseline p-value is close to the significance threshold, then returns to zero as epsilon approaches infinity.", fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
fpr_pbc <- fpr_input %>%

```{r threshold-shift, eval=file.exists(file.path(out_dir, "tab4_threshold.csv"))}
t4_old <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "tab4_threshold.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
t4_new <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "tab4_threshold_reffix.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(identical(dim(t4_old), dim(t4_new)), identical(names(t4_old), names(t4_new)),
          identical(t4_old$dataset, t4_new$dataset), identical(t4_old$phase, t4_new$phase))

eps_cols <- c("eps_c05", "eps_lsr50", "eps_lsr10", "eps_fpr10")
diff_cells <- do.call(rbind, lapply(eps_cols, function(cl) {
  idx <- which(as.character(t4_old[[cl]]) != as.character(t4_new[[cl]]))
  if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(dataset = t4_old$dataset[idx], phase = t4_old$phase[idx], column = cl,
             submitted = as.character(t4_old[[cl]])[idx],
             reffix    = as.character(t4_new[[cl]])[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))

by_design <- if (is.null(diff_cells)) integer(0) else
  which(diff_cells$phase == "Output" & diff_cells$column %in% c("eps_lsr50", "eps_lsr10") &
        diff_cells$reffix == "---")
substantive <- if (is.null(diff_cells)) NULL else
  if (length(by_design)) diff_cells[-by_design, , drop = FALSE] else diff_cells

cat(sprintf("tab4_threshold の全セル数（ε 列のみ）: %d\n", nrow(t4_old) * length(eps_cols)))
cat(sprintf("  §4-2 の表記変更（Output 行の LSR 2 列 → `---`）: %d セル\n", length(by_design)))
cat(sprintf("  **値そのものが動いたセル: %d**\n",
            if (is.null(substantive)) 0L else nrow(substantive)))

if (!is.null(substantive) && nrow(substantive) > 0) {
  kable(substantive, caption = "**ε\\* 閾値が動いたセル**（投稿版 → 差し替え版）") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("\n→ **ε\\* 閾値は 1 セルも動かない。** 掲載する Table IV の数値はそのままでよい。\n")
}
```

```{r phase3-exclusions}
excl_new <- read.csv(file.path(eval_dir, "phase3_exclusions_reffix.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
excl_old <- data.frame(
  kind     = c("lsr", "lsr", "fpr"),
  dataset  = c("lung", "flchain", "flchain"),
  variable = c("ph.karno", "sample.yr", "kappa"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
key <- function(d) sort(paste(d$kind, d$dataset, d$variable))
same <- identical(key(excl_new), key(excl_old))

kable(excl_new %>% arrange(kind, dataset, variable),
      caption = "差し替え版で判定し直した Phase 3 除外集合") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("投稿版の除外集合と %s\n", ifelse(same, "**一致する（変わらない）**", "**食い違う**")))
if (!same) {
  cat("  投稿版のみ: ", paste(setdiff(key(excl_old), key(excl_new)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("  差し替え版のみ: ", paste(setdiff(key(excl_new), key(excl_old)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
stopifnot(same)
```

```{r artifact-list}
RF_ARTIFACTS <- c(
  "tab1_baseline", "tab2_lsr", "tab3_cindex_test", "tab4_threshold", "tab5_transition_zone",
  "tabS1_full_kpi", "tabS2_sim_params", "tabS3_fpr_summary",
  "fig1_lsr", "fig2_cindex_test", "fig3_hr_distribution", "fig4_hr_bias",
  "figS1_lsr_per_variable", "figS2_overfit_gap", "figS3_fpr", "figS4_fpr_by_variable")
exts <- function(nm) if (startsWith(nm, "tab")) c("csv", "tex", "xlsx") else c("png", "svg", "pdf")
files <- unlist(lapply(RF_ARTIFACTS, function(nm) file.path(out_dir, paste0(nm, "_reffix.", exts(nm)))))
info <- file.info(files)
kable(data.frame(file = basename(files), exists = file.exists(files),
                 size = ifelse(is.na(info$size), NA, info$size)),
      caption = sprintf("差し替え版の成果物（%d ファイル）", length(files))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
stopifnot(length(files) == 48, all(file.exists(files)))
cat("差し替え版 48 ファイルをすべて生成した ✅\n")

paper_files <- unlist(lapply(RF_ARTIFACTS, function(nm) file.path(out_dir, paste0(nm, ".", exts(nm)))))
if (!any(file.exists(paper_files))) {
  cat("The original-submission artifacts are not present in this copy; this check is skipped.\n")
} else {
stopifnot(all(file.exists(paper_files)))
cat(sprintf("投稿版 %d ファイルは存在し、本書は 1 つも上書きしていない（保存名はすべて `_reffix` 付き）\n",
            length(paper_files)))
}
```
